notes.title: Support 3DM during the Summer Sale.
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36980965/bd56238aa89e0e5861abd8f35a7f0d1e1d5c38a3.png[/img]

[h2]Hi All,[/h2]

3DM is a family-owned company that decided to do something different on Steam than everyone else. My little son, the hero for whom I created 3DM, is the driving force.

Interactive wallpapers created on the normal Unity 3D engine turned out to be a bigger problem than we expected. Years of hard work and interesting ideas have allowed full working support for Windows designs as 3D interactive wallpapers.

Investments in good programmers turned out to be the key to success for 3DM to finally start earning money for itself. :)

Unfortunately, some time ago Steam changed the display of programs on the main page, which significantly reduced the reach of 3DM. Imagine, your family business goes down 80% in one day. :(

Nevertheless, we have developed many unique designs that will go down in Steam history as 3DM is the only publisher of 3D interactive wallpapers worldwide. No one else in the world has created continuous 3D interactive wallpapers.

That's why I strongly encourage you to support family 3DM by buying our designs at the Summer Sale. This is a great time to get our designs at a great price.

Thank you for your support!

[h2]Best Regards,[/h2]
[b]3DM Greg[/b]

notes.title: The new wallpaper game is coming soon.
notes.notes:
Desktop Mars will be released soon in Early Access. Please, consider adding it to your Wishlist to be on time.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1895410/Desktop_Mars/

Desktop Mars is my new project where we combined constructive game and live wallpaper, all in the style of Minecraft / Voxel.

Build, collect, upgrade and expand your new population on Mars before Elon Musk does!

Main features:
-No rush on time - Build your colony in your style and time.

-Real day and night system - If you play at night, your colony will be at night as well.

-Displayed as wallpaper - Build your colony on Mars on your desktop when doing other stuff.

-Automatic pause - When you play your games, DesktopMars will pause for this moment.

-Automatic start with Windows - Your colony on Mars will start working when you run your PC.

-Steam disconnect - Hide your activity (game restart needed).

-Optimised - Optimised to reduce PC usage to the minimum.

-Settings check - The wallpaper will recognize your system setting and change it if needed. If not, please read "Community HUB/Discussions" or text me for help.

If you like the idea of this game, please consider adding it to your Wishlist to be on time.

Thanks for support.

Best Regards,
3DM Greg
